SeasonRecapParagraphs: The 2001 fall tennis archive is now anchored by five published girls dual-match reports. St. Andrew's opened the recovered stretch with a 5-2 win over Patrick Henry before dropping matches to Hilton Head Christian, Beaufort Academy, and Hilton Head Prep.

The record path leaves two unreported losses between the Sept. 6 Hilton Head Christian match and the early-October rematch with Hilton Head Christian. Those placeholders reconcile the newspaper's 1-4 overall, 0-3 region line before the Oct. 2 Hilton Head Christian result and the 1-6, 0-4 region line after the Oct. 18 Hilton Head Prep match.

Jennifer Tyre, Mary Wilkowski, Grace Wilkowski, Ann Cole, Alicia Jaramillo, Clara Rucker, Lauren Raebler, and Stephanie Vine all appear in the surviving line scores. Tyre and Mary Wilkowski won singles matches against Patrick Henry, and St. Andrew's also picked up doubles points against Hilton Head Christian and Hilton Head Prep.
